Respiratory review
Asthma was treated with inhaled albuterol. Wheezing improved after albuterol was administered for asthma. Albuterol treatment for asthma was continued.

Metabolic review
Metformin was prescribed to treat type 2 diabetes. Nausea developed after metformin was started; the clinician attributed the nausea to metformin. Metformin treatment for type 2 diabetes was discontinued because of the nausea. Nausea resolved after metformin was stopped.

Sleep review
Zolpidem was prescribed to treat insomnia. Confusion developed after zolpidem was administered; the clinician attributed the confusion to zolpidem. Zolpidem treatment for insomnia was discontinued because of confusion. Confusion resolved after zolpidem was withdrawn.

Other findings
The sleep review did not discuss a relationship between asthma and zolpidem. No new treatment for asthma was proposed in this review.
